claims.date: 2026-10-09 (the file; the board's /api/jevbench/v1.6.1 is a frozen revision)
claims.text: On JevBench v1.6.1 (the board's file, October 2026), Decisio 31B scored 71.69 on the composite (95% interval 69.86 to 72.81) and Jev 1.13.0 scored 71.49 (69.14 to 72.40); the two intervals overlap.
On JevBench v1.6.1, the 31B's sealed-set intelligence was 73.3 and Jev 1.13.0's 61.6; the open-set intelligence was 67.6 and 65.6.
On JevBench v1.6.1, Decisio 31B's axes were intelligence 70.4 (Jev 1.13.0 63.6), calibration 88.7 (90.6), speed 91.2 (91.5) and cost 51.7 (54.7).
On the board's Capability table as read on 2026-10-18 (a page that merges later draws), Decisio 31B scored 79.57 (95% interval 75.67 to 81.99) and Jev 1.13.0 77.13 (72.77 to 78.37).

On one box (one RTX PRO 6000 at 600 W, one session on 2026-10-11), Decisio 31B answered 50 questions about a 3,000-token document in 1.08 s and about a 6,000-token document in 1.73 s; Jeff-1.0-Large took 47.1 s and 114.6 s, and Quyet-1.0-Large 48.9 s and 114.8 s; neither accepts a 32,000-token document (Decisio 31B: 10.1 s).
Our own run of Decisio 31B (decisio v0.6.0, 2026-10-05) on the Decision Index 0.2.1 scored 57.58 (a self-run, not a board score), with a median of 56.0 ms per request over 150,759 requests.

In our Ollama study (Ollama 0.35.0 on an Apple M5 Pro, measured 2026-09-30 and 2026-10-01), accuracy and expected calibration error on the 1,250-item suite were: decisio q4_k_m 0.775 and 0.089; nimble:9b 0.750 and 0.069; tev1:4b 0.678 and 0.061; tev1:0.8b 0.462 and 0.151. On JevBench's 231 published items they were: decisio q4_k_m 0.853 and 0.045; nimble:9b 0.797 and 0.097; tev1:4b 0.762 and 0.094; tev1:0.8b 0.615 and 0.136. The paired 95% interval of decisio q4_k_m minus nimble:9b was +2.6 [+0.5, +4.6] points of accuracy on the suite and +5.6 [+0.9, +10.4] on JevBench.

Decisio's three entries are listed on the Decision Index board; in its data file of 2026-10-14 (Decision Index 0.3.2) they scored, as the public index and then the edition 0.3 index: decisio 0.6.0 (Gemma 4 31B) 58.09 and 58.55; decisio 0.4.0 (Gemma 4 12B) 49.72 and 47.47; decisio 0.4.0 (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B) 48.43 and 47.72.

stable_claims.rule: Public texts say what was measured, on which board revision or session, on what date, and link to the live board (https://benchmarkheaven.com/jev-models) for current standings. Facts about Decisio itself (what it does, what it costs to run, its own measured accuracy and latency, teaching.intent_heads) need no board.
